text:
sara_sales: Quick heads-up — Demo for Zephyr (POC tenant) hitting 429s during live walkthrough. Started ~10:07 PT. Customer sees repeated 429s on high-concurrency embed + chat blend calls.

sara_sales: Error seen in client: `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests` with `Retry-After: 4` but it keeps coming even after backoff.

devon_se: Can you paste the raw response headers and example request pattern? how many concurrent streams/embeds they run?

sara_sales: Their test spawns 12 concurrent embedding requests + 8 chat completions, each embedding call is ~1k items batched at 16. So effectively a lot of concurrent token work.

sara_sales: Response headers snippet:
```
x-rate-limit-limit: 120
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 1759994370
Retry-After: 4
```

ops_bot: [alert] tenant=zephyr env=demo region=us-west-2 throttle_rate=0.18 average_latency_tokens=23ms

ash_engineer: Quick hypothesis: per-route caps are being applied separately to embeddings and chat, but our routing treats each as a different route and the tenant has a shared token budget — combined they exceed the tenant burst. That explains remaining=0 even though each route individually looks fine.

linh_ml: Also saw a subtle issue before: streaming responses were not counted toward the burst window properly in older SDK versions. If they use chunked streams, tokens might be underreported and the bucket drains unexpectedly when finalization happens. Which SDK version are they on?

mike_support: Customer on rdx-js 0.9.1 (we flagged streaming patch in 1.0.0). Recommend a quick repro with SDK disabled streaming or upgraded client.

devon_se: Can we get a short log tail from the serving proxy around 1759994360-75? Need to see how the token accounting occurred across routes.

ash_engineer: Pasted trimmed proxy log (timestamps are ms):
```
[1759994362.112] tenant=zephyr route=/v1/embeddings tokens=184 bucket_before=45 bucket_after=15
[1759994362.334] tenant=zephyr route=/v1/chat tokens=230 bucket_before=15 bucket_after=0 throttle=1 -> 429
[1759994363.101] tenant=zephyr route=/v1/embeddings tokens=200 bucket_before=0 bucket_after=0 throttle=1 -> 429
```

linh_ml: Looks like embedding + chat consumed the last of the burst within ~1s. Two mitigations: 1) lower per-route concurrency in the POC client (serialize embedding batches or reduce batch size), 2) temporary tenant soft-bump on burst size for the demo.

sara_sales: Customer asked about quick config changes they can do themselves. Which is faster? Reduce concurrency or upgrade SDK?

mike_support: Fastest = reduce concurrency to 4 embedding jobs and batch size 8. That should smooth bursts. Upgrading SDK takes time for them to test. Also set exponential backoff on 429 with jitter.

devon_se: For immediate mitigation I can open a short-lived quota override for tenant=zephyr (60m, +50% burst). Want me to proceed?

sara_sales: Please do — we need the demo to finish. Also log the change so we can revert.

devon_se: Opening override now. Request ID: qov-20260321-0893. Patch applied: tenant.zephyr.burst_multiplier=1.5 ttl=3600

ops_bot: [quota-change] applied tenant=zephyr by=devon_se id=qov-20260321-0893 expires=1759997921

ash_engineer: Follow-up PR to consider: combine per-route accounting into a single tenant token budget view for demo tenants, or at least surface combined projected remaining in console. Will draft RFC.

linh_ml: Also propose a small runtime guard: if x-rate-limit-remaining=0 for any route and there is concurrent traffic from same tenant, return a single 429 with header `x-rate-limit-aggregate: true` and a recommended wait. That will make backoff behavior deterministic for clients.

mike_support: Customer confirmed after override + reduced concurrency that the demo completed. They still want a note in the POC runbook about concurrency and embedding batch sizing.

sara_sales: Awesome — please add a one-pager to the presales runbook: recommended concurrency & batching for demo tenants. Short checklist: SDK version >=1.0.0, embed batch <=8, concurrent embed jobs <=4, client backoff jitter.

devon_se: Will create runbook item and tag presales-docs. Also linking internal ticket: INT-3197 for RFC on combined accounting.

sara_sales: Thanks all! :tada:
